title: benchmarks.py repro pick applies the landing rule, and repro replay puts one instance's commits on a work branch
goal: repro pick [--rows CSV] prints the instance the landing rule picks from the repro-compare and repro rows of kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv or CSV (most eval_passed, then the fewest check_errors plus lint_errors, then the lowest summed cost) and exits 1 when there are none; repro replay --instance N --item ID [--dir DIR] fetches the instance's main from its bare copy and rebases its commits since the start commit onto the current branch (git rebase --onto), adding the trailer KB-Work: ID to each, and stops on a conflict naming the conflicting files; neither command fetches from or pushes to the real origin; no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle gains a body that picks between two planted instances and replays one onto a planted main.

run:
import importlib.util,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
if importlib.util.find_spec('bench_repro') is None: print('no bench_repro module yet'); sys.exit(1)
import csv,os,tempfile
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'b.csv')
F=['scenario','record','date','commit','claude_code','kb_topics','case','arm','model','metric','value','runs','note']
rows=[('repro-compare','instance-1','eval_passed','40'),('repro-compare','instance-2','eval_passed','44'),('repro-compare','instance-1','check_errors','0'),('repro-compare','instance-2','check_errors','0'),('repro-compare','instance-1','lint_errors','0'),('repro-compare','instance-2','lint_errors','1'),('repro','instance-1','cost','50'),('repro','instance-2','cost','55')]
with open(f,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as h:
    w=csv.DictWriter(h,F); w.writeheader()
    for s,a,m,v in rows: w.writerow({'scenario':s,'record':'abc1234','date':'2026-10-16','commit':'abc1234','case':'all','arm':a,'metric':m,'value':v})
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','repro','pick','--rows',f],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()[-200:]); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and 'instance-2' in p.stdout else 1)
